install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; go mod download; if ! command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! golangci-lint --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q '2.11.4'; then curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/HEAD/install.sh | sh -s -- -b "$HOME/.local/bin" v2.11.4; fi
